# Qwen3.8 Flash Next, GGUF

Qwen3.8 Flash Next is a hybrid model, designed for efficient long-context and agentic workloads. Its architecture combines Gated DeltaNet with Qwen Sparse Attention, Gated Residuals, and n-gram embeddings for efficient scaling and inference. It has native vision and video understanding. The model targets efficient deployment while reducing long-context latency and memory demands.

This repository holds Vultr's GGUF quantizations of it. They are hybrid quantizations: rather than applying one precision to the whole network, each layer's precision is chosen from a measured importance score, so the bits go where they change the output most.

The vision encoder is in `Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-mmproj-f16.gguf` (904 MB). llama.cpp downloads it automatically with the command under Run, so image input works without extra steps.

KL divergence measures how far a quantized model's next-token probabilities drift from those of the original bf16 model, averaged over every token of the evaluation text. The lower the value, the closer the quantized model is to the original; zero would mean identical output.

## Evaluation

Every variant in this repository was evaluated against the original bf16 model for perplexity, KL divergence and top-token agreement, under identical conditions. The full results are maintained on the model's page in the Vultr Model Library:

**https://docs.vultr.com/models/alibaba-qwen-38/qwen3.8-flash-next?tab=quantized**

That page is the reference for these files. The summary above is an excerpt from it.

HellaSwag and WinoGrande are not included: llama.cpp cannot yet score multiple-choice tasks on this architecture.

## Run

    llama-server -hf vultr/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF:Q4_K_M

The model's chat template is embedded in every file, so no extra prompt formatting is needed.

The repository also includes `mtp-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Q8_0.gguf`, the model's multi-token prediction (MTP) head, for optional speculative decoding with any quant above:

    llama-server -hf vultr/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF:Q4_K_M --spec-type draft-mtp
